clarity.notes: The v2 thesis is visible on load: the approved shell (menubar/dock/windows) framing the routes users already know. The window head doubling as the route topbar removes the double-chrome ambiguity v1 would force.

hierarchy.notes: Opaque production-canvas windows read as 'the app'; glass is reserved for shell furniture (menubar, dock, popovers, widgets). Focused window carries the stronger border/shadow.

typography.notes: Verbatim production stack: Inter with cv01/ss03, 13.5px base, -.006em tracking; JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for numerics, ids and paths.

motion.notes: Same single flourish family as v1 (dock magnification + genie minimize) on the production duration/easing tokens; reduce-motion honored via media query and settings.

brand.notes: Token block copied verbatim from the production lineage (dashboard.html ← agent-detail.html ← packages/ui tokens.css); zero color literals outside it. Signal vocabulary corrected to production: running = pulsing accent dot, needs = warning, failed = danger.

checks.polish_pass_root_cause: fixed — the broken sessions rail was a stale one-off: the removed Sessions-window CSS block (.session-row{display:flex;height:28px} etc.) survived in os-v2-apps.css and, loading after os-v2.css, crushed the rail's grid rows. Block deleted; comm -12 over class selectors of both sheets now returns empty (no cross-file component collisions).
checks.polish_pass_details: menubar 38→44px (badge/tray breathing), ⌘K chip simplified to text-only, session-row sub/time bumped one contrast step (faint→subtle, subtle→muted) with tabular-nums, ember wallpaper depth raised one tint step, sessions dock badge now counts waiting sessions (not approvals), desktop empty state teaches ⌘K/dock when zero windows are open.
checks.token_provenance: pass — all hex/rgba literals confined to the verbatim :root blocks in os-v2.css; apps CSS, HTML and JS are 100% var()-based
checks.view_mode_contract: pass — Tasks and Sandbox windows ship Rows|Cards PillGroups (aria-label="View mode") + .listing-card-grid; Marketplace stays cards-only per catalog IA v3
checks.sidebar_parity: pass — dock mirrors app-sidebar.tsx routes in sidebar order with group separators; Settings intentionally relocated to the menu-bar cog per user direction (AGH has no user/avatar concept), still reachable via ⌘K
checks.minimize_model: pass — no tray: minimizing folds the window into its own dock icon (genie targets the icon; dimmed glyph + hollow run-dot marks minimized; click restores) — minimized count can never displace the dock
checks.scope_trim: pass — desktop widgets removed (deferred by user), cost readout, mesh chip and clock removed from the menu bar; approvals live in the bell popover only
checks.sessions_rail: pass — Sessions renders as a floating rounded left rail on the dock shell (glass, 22px radius, 10px margins), transcribing sidebar-sessions-02: 2-line recent rows (status shapes, agent·state sub), search, Show all sessions → agent groups with the data-collapsed grid-rows contract persisted to localStorage; dock order is Sessions first, Dashboard second, and the dock glides right via flex-grow spacer collapse while the rail is open
checks.visual_capture: skipped — render helper blocked in this environment; user preview is the visual gate
